link.note: Named as mother in Thomas Heffernan's 1808 Gortnahoe baptism (Dwyer).

summary: Wife of Humphrey Heffernan, a miner of Lickfinn in the parish of Gortnahoe, County Tipperary; John's 5th-great-grandmother.
bio: Anastasia Ryan married Humphrey Heffernan, a miner of Lickfinn in the parish of Gortnahoe, County Tipperary. The couple were raising their family there between 1805 and 1817, when at least five sons were baptized at Gortnahoe. She was John's 5th-great-grandmother.
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh
